notes.title: New Demo Update: Controller Support + Smarter Balance
notes.notes: [h3]🛠️ [b]Update: Controller Support Added + Gameplay Rebalanced![/b][/h3][p]Hey adventurers![/p][p]We just pushed a fresh update to the demo — and it’s a big one, especially for those who like playing with a controller in hand.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 Full Controller Support is Now Live![/h3][p]You can now play the entire demo using your favorite controller (Xbox, PlayStation, etc.). Wall runs, trap dodging, ledge balancing — all fully mapped and tuned for smooth gamepad control.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚔️ Gameplay & Enemy Rebalancing[/h3][p]We’ve made several balance adjustments based on your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]Smarter enemy pacing and positioning[/p][/*][*][p]Improved difficulty curve for smoother progression[/p][/*][*][p]Maze and dungeon areas are still challenging, but more fair and readable[/p][/*][*][p]Combat encounters feel more rewarding without being overwhelming[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you gave up at the maze  or just wanted a more polished flow — this one’s for you.[/p][hr][/hr][p]If you tried the demo before, now’s a great time to jump back in and feel the improvements. And if you haven’t yet, what are you waiting for? Go give it a run, wishlist the game, and let us know what you think![/p]
